text.3:26: Say: O Allah! Owner of Sovereignty! Thou givest sovereignty unto whom Thou wilt, and Thou withdrawest sovereignty from whom Thou wilt. Thou exaltest whom Thou wilt, and Thou abasest whom Thou wilt. In Thy hand is the good. Lo! Thou art Able to do all things.
text.7:27: O Children of Adam! Let not Satan seduce you as he caused your (first) parents to go forth from the Garden and tore off from them their robe (of innocence) that he might manifest their shame to them. Lo! he seeth you, he and his tribe, from whence ye see him not. Lo! We have made the devils protecting friends for those who believe not.
text.7:43: And We remove whatever rancour may be in their hearts. Rivers flow beneath them. And they say: The praise to Allah, Who hath guided us to this. We could not truly have been led aright if Allah had not guided us. Verily the messengers of our Lord did bring the Truth. And it is cried unto them: This is the Garden. Ye inherit it for what ye used to do.
text.7:108: And he drew forth his hand (from his bosom), and lo! it was white for the beholders.
text.11:9: And if we cause man to taste some mercy from Us and afterward withdraw it from him, lo! he is despairing, thankless.
text.15:47: And We remove whatever rancour may be in their breasts. As brethren, face to face, (they rest) on couches raised.
text.19:69: Then We shall pluck out from every sect whichever of them was most stubborn in rebellion to the Beneficent.
text.26:33: And he drew forth his hand and lo! it was white to the beholders.
text.28:75: And We shall take out from every nation a witness and We shall say: Bring your proof. Then they will know that Allah hath the Truth, and all that they invented will have failed them.
text.54:20: Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm-trees.
